comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The part that stopped me: on 30 March 2017, linguists in Belgrade, Zagreb, Sarajevo and Podgorica published the same declaration at the same hour, saying Bosnian, Croatian, Montenegrin and Serbian are one common standard language of the polycentric type, with four equal variants and no need for an interpreter. Over two hundred signed first, thousands after, and all four names stayed official. Sources are listed in the description. If you live where one language carries several names, or several names carry one language, what do you call yours at home?
